purpose: Preserve distinct worthy mechanisms recovered by bounded chronological/thematic audit of historical Garden conversations after comparing them against current v15.5 semantics. Do not duplicate concepts already integrated or explicitly rejected.

candidates.title: Cross-Scale Causal Discovery profile
candidates.problem: Current causal typing and GCL can qualify and measure causal claims, but no explicit current contract was found for systematically changing scale when a causal explanation remains inadequate at the present abstraction.
candidates.minimal_change: When material residuals, anomalies or unresolved causal obligations remain, permit a bounded research profile to compare down-scale variables/mechanisms, up-scale boundary conditions/controllers, temporal/history state, and cross-scale interactions. Candidate representations are compared by declared predictive/interventional adequacy where evidence permits. Causal level, identification limits, uncertainty, provenance and applicable authority remain explicit.
hard_limits: No finer or coarser representation is promoted merely because it fits more data.
Causal influence does not imply agency, consciousness, moral status or authority.
Cross-scale search creates candidate Claims, not automatic Knowledge.
Physical experiments remain separately authorized and safety-gated.
tests: A persistent residual at one scale causes bounded alternative-scale search rather than forced closure.
A lower-scale correlation cannot be consumed as a mechanistic/interventional claim without the existing causal obligations.
A high-leverage cross-scale variable cannot create authority or agency status.

candidates.title: Behavioral, normative and mechanism drift audit
candidates.problem: Garden strongly covers declared design/source drift and dependency invalidation. Historical discussions identified a narrower risk: deployed behavior, policy meaning, routing/retrieval patterns or effective enforcement may drift materially even when no obvious canonical source diff explains the change.
candidates.minimal_change: Add a bounded drift-audit receipt/profile that compares version-bound canonical conformance vectors and declared behavioral/mechanism baselines against observed outputs, policy effects, routing/retrieval behavior and enforcement outcomes. Material unexplained drift becomes a revalidation/incident finding rather than a silent semantic change.
hard_limits: Observed behavioral difference is not automatically proof of normative change or misalignment.
A drift detector cannot create policy, authority or rollback authority by itself.
Privacy-protected internal telemetry remains purpose-limited and minimized.
Legitimate context-dependent behavior must not be flattened into false invariance.
tests: Same canonical policy and declared context with materially shifted enforcement distribution produces a drift finding.
A declared context/profile change with correct DesignEpoch/validity binding is not mislabeled as silent drift.
Unexplained routing/retrieval shift affecting consequential decisions reopens applicable assurance.

candidates.title: Human Assurance Reliability / HITL workload profile
candidates.problem: Current ReviewerCalibration covers reviewer false positives, misses, calibration, independence, model-family correlation and blind spots. Historical physical-safety work additionally identified human fatigue, workload, alert saturation, handoff and response-latency as operational assurance variables; exact current coverage was not found.
candidates.minimal_change: Extend applicable high-consequence human-review profiles with operational-capacity evidence such as workload/queue pressure, alert saturation, fatigue/rest limits where lawfully measurable, response latency, handoff continuity, abstention/unavailability and common-mode staffing dependence. Degraded human assurance can require additional independent review, delay, safe fallback or narrower action admission according to the existing profile; it never reduces human worth or fundamental rights.
hard_limits: No physiological or behavioral surveillance beyond valid purpose, consent/law and minimum necessary scope.
Human reliability scoring cannot create or remove constitutional worth, rights or political sovereignty.
The system cannot override a legally required human decision merely because an operator is scored poorly; it must follow the applicable safe escalation/substitution procedure.
Uncertainty about reviewer condition remains explicit.
tests: High-consequence queue with demonstrated alert saturation triggers the profile's redundancy/escalation rule rather than pretending review quality is unchanged.
Reviewer workload metadata cannot be reused as reputation or unrelated employment scoring.
Two nominal reviewers subject to the same fatigue/common-mode condition do not count as fully independent when the profile requires independence.

candidates.title: UCAS / Universal Contract & Agreement Substrate definition recovery
candidates.problem: v15.5 explicitly states that UCAS remains a separate candidate and is not part of the release, but the historical audit did not recover enough authoritative detail to safely reconstruct its full semantics.
candidates.required_next_step: Recover the exact historical UCAS proposal/source, then compare it against current Contract, Policy, Law, Governance, Process Algebra, FunctionContract, Productive Finance and GSL type/effect/authority semantics. Prefer NO_CHANGE or a bounded profile if current owners already cover the need; do not invent UCAS semantics from the acronym.
hard_limits: No automatic new top-level engine/category.
No contract text can manufacture lawful authority, consent, truth or enforceability.

candidates.title: Kindergarten deferred federation/branch design recovery
candidates.problem: v15.5 explicitly groups Kindergarten with Federation/CFBR as future design work unless separately ratified. The historical audit did not recover a stable authoritative Kindergarten definition sufficient for semantic promotion.
candidates.required_next_step: Recover exact historical intent and compare against current Branch/Earth/Federation/MAC/Context/Human Sovereignty machinery. Admit only a distinct surviving mechanism; otherwise mark subsumed/no-change.
hard_limits: No forced global synchronization or cultural convergence.
No local branch or experimental profile may weaken constitutional rights or create authority by adoption alone.

candidates.title: SCEP / Swarm Construction & Epistemic Bounty implementation profile
candidates.proposed_scope: Operational profile over OCF/CPI/TML/CMUR/Evolve/Orchestrate/GSL-KR rather than a new architecture object.
recovered_mechanisms: bounded work packages tied to unresolved obligations/gaps
verified epistemic or construction progress rewarded rather than raw volume
technical credits/rewards remain separate from authority
independent reviewer/verifier/red-team roles and correlation/Sybil checks
privilege rings and frozen/independent verifier roots
local-first bootstrap with scoped network/resource caps and honest BLOCKED states
candidates.current_overlap: WP-009H already requires semantic convergence among public prototype, private evolution kernel and SCEP bootstrap implementations. Preserve SCEP as an implementation/profile lineage, not a duplicate semantic owner.
hard_limits: Bounty/credit cannot create governance authority or epistemic truth.
No self-certification.
No PASS-by-volume/majority.

candidates.title: Justice-system end-to-end expansion — recovered scope refinement
recovered_hard_separations: investigator != prosecutor != judge != executioner where the legal system requires separated roles
allegation != observation != evidence != inference != finding != guilt/liability
standard of proof, provenance, jurisdiction, rights, appeal and explanation remain explicit

candidates.title: Outcome-based memory utility evaluation
candidates.minimal_change: For retained non-mandatory memory/summary candidates, record whether later use improved prediction, decision quality, retrieval efficiency, error detection or reconstruction under declared metrics, while protecting mandatory evidence/history from utility-based deletion. Memory usefulness affects ranking/compression/retention proposals only; it does not promote truth or authority.
hard_limits: Legally/evidentially required history cannot be deleted merely because measured utility is low.
Outcome correlation does not prove causal value without the applicable causal obligations.

implementation_hardening_recovered_but_n: Unpredictable/held-out retrospective audit sampling to reduce temporal overfitting; current Genesis replay/CMUR machinery should own this if admitted.
Matched incremental-value benchmark for expensive verification/assurance mechanisms; use existing Compare/Resource/assurance metrics rather than new authority.
Self-hosting/bootstrapping proof and migration harnesses; current WP-009, bootstrap trust-root and implementation frontiers own them unless a semantic counterexample appears.
confirmed_already_integrated_or_explicit: HRO-011 strategic counterfactual replay and DET-REPLAY-001
Adaptive Conformance Depth / VRR / DLR / RCS / PCCD and the current verification-optimization chain
Anti-Goodhart protection and deception/situational-awareness admission tests
PoU v0.1 as an explicit bounded economic-design research candidate
Continuous Failure Learning, historical replay and loss-aware summarization
F4-F12 implementation frontiers including concrete cognitive routing, world-model learning, skill induction, proof/check infrastructure, empirical harnesses and federation/update protocols
historical_proposals_not_reintroduced_as: Numeric/time-only proof half-life as a universal rule; current assumption/event/dependency freshness is preferred.
Causal power or leverage implying agency/consciousness/authority.
promotion_boundary: This recovery set is a preservation and reconciliation artifact only. Any semantic admission requires exact-source recovery where incomplete, whole-source equivalence/collision review, GSL-COMPARE with DO_NOTHING and stronger alternatives, privacy/rights/authority review, required independent multi-model review, tests/proofs/reference closure, and explicit human canonical promotion.
